note: The desk register: what this newsroom is configured to run, in one place. Two checks read it. The canary asserts the workflow files match it exactly, so a stale cron or a placeholder cannot survive a push. The morning tally compares the Actions log and the ledger to it and prints one health line. Cron times are UTC; the ET column is Eastern and shifts by an hour when DST ends on 1 November.
worker_dispatches: inactives.yml in its posting windows (its only trigger since N-1)
sports-news-brief.yml at the evening slot until Jack removes the window from the Worker; the run it starts skips

scores-cadence.yml every ten minutes, 6 AM hour and 10 AM to 2:59 AM ET, from the Worker's N-1 deploy (not live on November 25 2026; until it is, the scores-start job in inactives.yml and sports-news-brief.yml starts the run)

sports-news-brief.yml.purpose: OFF since 2026-10-12: the recap, storyline, lane and Edition job (was the one Edition run a day). Code kept.
sports-news-brief.yml.note: Gated on NEWSROOM_JOBS (unset), so any dispatch skips and spends nothing.

inactives.yml.purpose: The Sunday inactives poller. Its dated snapshots are the record.
inactives.yml.note: No model calls. A tick that captures nothing costs seconds and no commit.
inactives.yml.trigger_note: N-1 (2026-11-21): the Worker dispatches it every five minutes in its Eastern windows; the GitHub crons are removed.

verify-sports-pipeline.yml.note: Also runs on every push. Layer 1 is offline and makes no model call.

sports-aging.yml.purpose: Monthly aging review, and the venue-corrections review listing.

conditions-report.yml.purpose: The conditions report (Program 7, S-2b): written from the conditions Worker's numbers by template, gated, committed and pushed. Calls no model. Each run is one build.

scores-cadence.yml.purpose: Game-day scores (Sprint A of the November 7 2026 audit, A2; the re-read, S-DONE, November 25 2026): cadence.py decides on each tick whether a build is due; a due tick commits site/data/scoreboard.json and that push builds the site. While a game window is on, each tick also commits the board as the site's renderer draws it under site/data/live/ (live_board.py), a push that never builds; the home and the Scores page read it from the repository. A run that finds a window on, or a kickoff inside six hours, holds it at five-minute ticks and hands over to a new run before six hours. Calls no model, reads no secret. J-17 holds Jack's word on the weekend builds.

crons.et: 5:07 to 7:37 AM ET daily, for the 6:00 AM build
every 10 min, 10 AM to 6:59 PM EST (11 AM to 7:59 PM EDT)
every 10 min, 7 PM to 1:59 AM EST (8 PM to 2:59 AM EDT)

scores-cadence.yml.trigger_note: N-1 (2026-11-21): the Worker's next deploy dispatches it every ten minutes through the day's games; its crons stay until that deploy is live, then go.

health.yml.purpose: N-1 health gate: once a day at 7 AM ET reads the last 24 hours of run conclusions, the scores snapshots and the public site's stamps, and fails, one mail, only when the site has not built for a full day or the scores went more than two hours without a reading while a game was on. docs/HEALTH.md in gcm-newsroom.

newsroom: OFF from 2026-10-12 (Program 7, S-1 item 3): sports-news-brief.yml has no schedule key and its job is gated on the repository variable NEWSROOM_JOBS, unset. served_slots and the slot table in watcher.py are kept for the day it returns; no slot is served while it is off.
